home.title: Collect measurements together on a map
home.lead: Define an area, share the link and let others enter temperature, air quality or well-being. The heatmap shows right away where it is warm, cool or stuffy.
home.point_map: Public map with link or QR code, usable without an account
home.point_iot: Sensors (e.g. ESP32) send values with an API token

auth.username_hint: 3–32 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen
auth.no_email: No email address is needed. An admin can reset your password.

profile.title: Profile
profile.password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
profile.reset_hint: Forgot your password? An admin can reset it for you.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: There are no projects here yet.
projects.err_name: Please give the project a name.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.slug_help: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. Part of the link.
settings.slug_warning: The map link will change; old links and QR codes will stop working.

settings.editable_help: Without signing in; you can hide or delete measurements at any time.
settings.area_help: {{count}} measurements lie in the area. Center and radius can only change while all measurements stay inside the new circle.
settings.metrics_help: The form always shows all metrics. Individual values may stay empty when entering.

settings.share_help: Link, QR code and data export (CSV, GeoJSON, map image).
settings.archive_help: Stays readable but accepts no more measurements. Can be reactivated at any time.
settings.delete_help: Permanently removes the project and all measurements. Owners and admins only.
settings.delete_message: Permanently delete “{{name}}” with all measurements? This cannot be undone.

entry.name: Name (optional)

entry.saved_with_window: Measurement saved. You can edit or delete it for {{minutes}} minutes.

share.title: Share
share.qr_label: QR code that opens the map
share.with_view: Include current time range and metric
share.copy_failed: Copying is not possible. Please select the link by hand.

export.title: Export
export.svg_help: SVG contains vector shapes only (heatmap, circle, points, legend, scale bar), no map background. Choose PNG or JPEG for an image with the map.
export.basemap_help: The server loads the map and adds it to the image with attribution; this can take a few seconds.
export.nomap_help: The image shows heatmap, circle, points and scale bar on a neutral background.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: A token lets sensors and scripts send measurements without signing in. The token is shown only once.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.created_hint: Copy the token now. You will not be able to show it again.
tokens.examples_intro: Replace <host>, <projekt-id>, <messgroessen-id> and <token>. You find the IDs in the project settings or under /api/projects/<projekt-id> in the metrics field.

admin.registration_help: When off, new users can only be created by admins.
admin.password_reset_done: Password reset. Existing sessions were ended.
admin.delete_message: Delete “{{name}}”? Measurements are kept but lose their author.
